description: One item's statistical seasonal shape from its own sales history: 12 monthly factors (mean-normalized to average 1.0), how many months of data produced them, and a 0..1 pattern confidence. Use it to judge whether an item is seasonal at all (hasSeasonalData) and as the starting points for create_demand_curve when no existing curve fits.
name: get_item_seasonal_shape
title: Item Seasonal Shape
